EdgeProp Singapore is a Real Estate company. EdgeProp.sg is a company that provides property information and services for sale and rent in Singapore. They offer a wide range of properties including apartments, condos, HDBs, landed properties, commercial properties, and factory properties. They also provide free property analytics data tools. EdgeProp Singapore employs 60 people and has an annual revenue of $3M, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Singapore, with an office in Singapore. Its workforce is distributed across Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, and Argentina. Has $4M in total funding.

EdgeProp is an unfunded company based in Singapore (Singapore), founded in 2015 by Bernard Tong Kim Chun. It operates as a Provider of an online listing platform to buy, sell or rent residential and commercial properties. EdgeProp has not raised any funding yet. The company has 35 active competitors, including 5 funded and 4 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like PropertyGuru, 99 Group and OnTheMarket.

searchResults.title: EdgeProp - Products, Competitors, Financials, Employees ...
searchResults.highlight: EdgeProp is a real estate portal that provides tools and resources for property seekers, investors, and real estate professionals. The platform facilitates the buying, selling, and renting of properties including condominiums, HDB flats, landed houses, commercial, and industrial properties, and provides access to property news, analytics, and valuation tools. EdgeProp serves the real estate industry by offering services for individual home-seekers and real estate agents. It is based in Singapore.
